<js>
// ===== 全民小说 登录面板/线路运维函数库 v1.1 =====
// 按钮 action 统一 QM_xxx(java)；函数只使用显式传入的 java(SourceLoginJsExtensions)，
// 对 source/infoMap/result 一律 try/catch 多通道兜底，兼容 LT 与 legado-E 的绑定差异。
function login(){ return 'ok'; }
function QM_T(jv,msg){
 var ok=false;
 try{jv.longToast(msg);ok=true}catch(e){}
 if(!ok)try{jv.toast(msg);ok=true}catch(e2){}
 if(!ok)try{jv.copyText(msg)}catch(e3){}
}
function QM_gv(jv,k,d){var v='';try{v=String(jv.get(k)||'')}catch(e){};if(!v||v==='null'||v==='undefined')v=d||'';return v;}
function QM_put(jv,k,v){
 try{jv.put(k,v);return true}catch(e){}
 try{source.put(k,v);return true}catch(e2){}
 return false;
}
function QM_re(jv){try{jv.reLoginView()}catch(e){try{jv.reUiView(true)}catch(e2){}}}
// 发布页输入框多通道读取：loginInfoMap / source / java / result / infoMap 依次尝试
function QM_pub(jv){
 var key='🔗 发布页地址',def='https://bqm.125ks.cn/jc/v.php',p='';
 try{var m=jv.getLoginInfoMap();if(m&&m.get)p=String(m.get(key)||'')}catch(e){}
 if(!p)try{var m2=source.getLoginInfoMap();if(m2&&m2.get)p=String(m2.get(key)||'')}catch(e){}
 if(!p)try{var r=result;if(r&&r.get)p=String(r.get(key)||'')}catch(e){}
 if(!p)try{p=String(infoMap[key]||'')}catch(e){}
 if(!p)p=QM_gv(jv,'qm_pub',def);
 p=p.trim();if(!p)p=def;
 if(p.indexOf('http')!==0)p='https://'+p;
 return p;
}
function QM_help(jv){
 QM_T(jv,'ℹ️ 全民小说为游客接口，无需账号登录。\n面板用法：\n① 在「🔗 发布页地址」输入网址 → 点「① 一键获取网址路线」\n② 点「② 测试延时」测得各站 ms 并写回按钮\n③ 点「🌐 网址N」切换当前线路；「✅ 检查登录状态」实测书城接口且不触发搜索。');
}
function QM_checkLogin(jv){
 QM_T(jv,'⏳ 正在检查游客登录状态（只测书城接口，不访问搜索）...');
 var base=QM_gv(jv,'qm_line','https://book.yutinglu.com').replace(/\/$/,'');
 if(base.indexOf('http')!==0)base='https://'+base;
 var url=base+'/book_city/v7/index/1/0/1.html'+',{"timeout":10000,"retry":0}';
 var t0=Date.now(),ok=false,ms='',info='';
 try{
  var r=String(jv.ajax(url));ms=(Date.now()-t0)+'ms';
  if(r.indexOf('"code":1')>=0||r.indexOf('"content"')>=0){ok=true;info='游客态可用，服务端已下发 uid Cookie';}
  else if(r.indexOf('登录')>=0||/401|403/.test(r))info='需要登录或被拦截：'+r.substring(0,80);
  else info='响应异常：'+r.substring(0,80);
 }catch(e){ms=(Date.now()-t0)+'ms';info='请求失败：'+String(e).substring(0,100);}
 QM_T(jv,(ok?'✅ 检查完成：':'⚠️ 检查完成：')+info+'\n耗时 '+ms+'\n线路 '+base);
 QM_put(jv,'qm_login_status',(ok?'游客态可用':'异常')+' '+ms);
 QM_re(jv);
}
function QM_showLine(jv){QM_T(jv,'📡 当前线路：'+QM_gv(jv,'qm_line','https://book.yutinglu.com（官方默认）'));QM_re(jv);}
function QM_setPub(jv){
 QM_T(jv,'⏳ 正在保存发布页输入框...');
 var p=QM_pub(jv);QM_put(jv,'qm_pub',p);
 QM_T(jv,'✅ 发布页已保存：'+p+'\n下一步点「① 一键从发布页获取网址路线」');
 QM_re(jv);
}
function QM_fetchLines(jv){
 QM_T(jv,'⏳ 正在从发布页获取网址路线，并合并抓包实锤的官方域...');
 var pub=QM_pub(jv),html='';
 try{html=String(jv.ajax(pub+',{"timeout":10000,"retry":0}'))}catch(e){html='';}
 var lines=[],re=/(https?:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.-]+)/g,m;
 while((m=re.exec(html))!==null){
  var u=m[1].replace(/\/$/,'');
  if(/jquery|w3\.org|schema|google|apache/i.test(u))continue;
  if(lines.indexOf(u)<0)lines.push(u);
 }
 var official=['https://book.yutinglu.com','https://s.yutinglu.com','https://d.yutinglu.com','https://catalog.yutinglu.com','https://chapter.yutinglu.com','https://conf.yutinglu.com'];
 // 官方域优先且去重；发布页根域保留一条供测速
 var merged=[];
 for(var i=0;i<official.length;i++)if(merged.indexOf(official[i])<0)merged.push(official[i]);
 var pubRoot=pub.replace(/\/jc\/.*$/,'').replace(/\/$/,'');
 if(pubRoot&&merged.indexOf(pubRoot)<0)merged.splice(1,0,pubRoot);
 for(var j=0;j<lines.length&&merged.length<6;j++)if(merged.indexOf(lines[j])<0)merged.push(lines[j]);
 lines=merged.slice(0,6);
 QM_put(jv,'qm_lines',JSON.stringify(lines));
 for(var n=1;n<=6;n++){QM_put(jv,'qm_line'+n,lines[n-1]||'');QM_put(jv,'qm_sp'+n,'');}
 QM_T(jv,'✅ 获取完成：共 '+lines.length+' 条网址\n'+lines.join('\n')+'\n下一步点「② 测试延时」');
 QM_re(jv);
}
function QM_speedTest(jv){
 QM_T(jv,'⏳ 正在逐站测试延时（每站 8 秒超时；不访问搜索接口）...');
 var lines=[];
 for(var n=1;n<=6;n++){var a=QM_gv(jv,'qm_line'+n,'');if(a)lines.push(a);}
 if(!lines.length){QM_T(jv,'⚠️ 暂无网址，请先点「① 一键从发布页获取网址路线」');return;}
 var best='',bm=99999999,msg='';
 for(var i=0;i<lines.length;i++){
  var base=lines[i].replace(/\/$/,''),t0=Date.now(),st='超时',ok=false,el=0;
  // 只用连通性/书城/配置端点，绝不请求官方搜索端点
  var p='/';
  if(base.indexOf('book.yutinglu.com')>=0)p='/book_city/v7/index/1/0/1.html';
  else if(base.indexOf('conf.yutinglu.com')>=0)p='/a_package.html';
  else if(base.indexOf('d.yutinglu.com')>=0)p='/';
  try{
   var b=String(jv.ajax(base+p+',{"timeout":8000,"retry":0}'));
   el=Date.now()-t0;
   if(b.length>20){ok=true;st=el+'ms';}else st='空响应 '+el+'ms';
  }catch(e){el=Date.now()-t0;st='失败 '+el+'ms';}
  QM_put(jv,'qm_sp'+(i+1),st);
  msg+='\n'+(i+1)+'. '+base.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'')+'  '+st;
  if(ok&&el<bm){bm=el;best=base;}
 }
 if(best){var bi=lines.indexOf(best);QM_put(jv,'qm_sp'+(bi+1),'⚡'+QM_gv(jv,'qm_sp'+(bi+1),''));}
 QM_T(jv,'✅ 测延时完成（⚡=最快）：'+msg+'\nms 已写入各网址按钮，重新打开面板即可看到。');
 QM_re(jv);
}
function QM_useLine(jv,n){
 var a=QM_gv(jv,'qm_line'+n,'');
 if(!a){QM_T(jv,'⚠️ 网址'+n+'为空，请先点「① 一键从发布页获取网址路线」');return;}
 QM_put(jv,'qm_line',a.replace(/\/$/,''));
 QM_T(jv,'✅ 已切换到网址'+n+'：'+a+'\n（当前线路用于状态显示/测速；本源业务 URL 按 yutinglu.com 各子域职能固定，不整体替换域名）');
 QM_re(jv);
}
</js>
